subject: astronomy
title: Telescopes: Observing Tips
welcome_lead: Get the most from a clear night — let your eyes adjust.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: observing tips, light pollution, magnification.
final_note: Even small binoculars beat your bare eyes on the sky.

walkthroughs.body_html: City lights cause light pollution, washing out faint stars. Travel to a dark place if you can. Even moving away from a streetlight helps.
Give your eyes 20 minutes to adjust. Use a red torch for star charts — red light won't reset your night vision.
More magnification isn't always better. High power gives a blurry image if the air is shaky. Lower power gives sharper, wider views.
